svg.title: ConsultIQ query and response flow
svg.desc: Session and workspace authorization, scoped paginated queries including owner audit history, guarded manual writes with confirmed-save recovery, durable analysis admission, independent worker validation and atomic persistence, followed by validated telemetry reads and draft-safe client refresh.

text.tspan: Owner-only audit and storage reads, no
transcript or provider payload in job history
Editor pins baseline and evidence when opened,
Confirmed save survives a failed refresh, retry the read only
Lost write response stays uncertain, inspect
The browser may close, the durable job remains queued
Independent dispatch: one queued job per invocation
Up to 120 candidates, top five passages, no vector store
Guard workspace, consultation, running lease and relevant input/source state
No automatic paid retry, cancelled or expired
Delivery failure cannot replace the saved result or original error

svg.text: Resolve owner or membership in selected
Scoped summary, keyset page or selected
Explicit response fields, at most one extra
New job or matching existing job
Discover routing metadata, expire scoped leases, claim one job
Scoped job + three-minute nonrenewable lease, or no job
Recheck requester access and pinned assessment baseline
Check active rubric, load pinned rubric and transcript
Load transcript, keyword rank approved scoped passages
Fail job without a model call
processed: true, job contains failure status
Atomic result + actor audit + completed job
Mark running job failed when applicable, preserve terminal state
Completed metadata-only model and validation/save spans
Dispatch result, inspect job status for
Stored result or sanitized failure status
